Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اُوۡحِىَ اِلَىَّ اَنَّهُ اسۡتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ الۡجِنِّ فَقَالُوۡۤا اِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡاٰنًا عَجَبًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘It has been revealed to me that a party of the jinn listened to (my recitation) carefully and then (went back to their people and) said: Surely we have heard a wonderful Qur’an.

Verses.VerseAr: يَّهۡدِىۡۤ اِلَى الرُّشۡدِ فَاٰمَنَّا بِهٖ‌ؕ وَلَنۡ نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَاۤ اَحَدًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: It shows the path of guidance. So we have believed in it and will never set up any partner with our Lord.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاَنَّهٗ تَعٰلٰى جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَّلَا وَلَدًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that exalted High is the Glory of our Lord. He has taken to Himself neither any wife nor children.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاَنَّهٗ كَانَ يَقُوۡلُ سَفِيۡهُنَا عَلَى اللّٰهِ شَطَطًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that only a fool from among us used to utter things about Allah far from the Truth, crossing bounds.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاَنَّا ظَنَنَّاۤ اَنۡ لَّنۡ تَقُوۡلَ الۡاِنۡسُ وَالۡجِنُّ عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that we thought that man and jinn would never tell a lie against Allah.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَنَّهٗ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ الۡاِنۡسِ يَعُوۡذُوۡنَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ الۡجِنِّ فَزَادُوۡهُمۡ رَهَقًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that some of the men used to take shelter with some of the jinn. So they increased defiance among the jinn.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاَنَّهُمۡ ظَنُّوۡا كَمَا ظَنَنۡتُمۡ اَنۡ لَّنۡ يَّبۡعَثَ اللّٰهُ اَحَدًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, (O party of jinn,) those men also thought just as you thought that Allah would never raise up anyone (after death).

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاَنَّا لَمَسۡنَا السَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدۡنٰهَا مُلِئَتۡ حَرَسًا شَدِيۡدًا وَّشُهُبًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that we touched the heavens and found them filled with high-alert guards and stars shining and burning (like brands).

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاَنَّا كُنَّا نَقۡعُدُ مِنۡهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمۡعِ‌ؕ فَمَنۡ يَّسۡتَمِعِ الۡاٰنَ يَجِدۡ لَهٗ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that we used to sit on certain seats (in the heaven previously, to listen to the news), but if someone now seeks to listen then he will find a flame of fire (waiting) for him in ambush.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاَنَّا لَا نَدۡرِىۡۤ اَشَرٌّ اُرِيۡدَ بِمَنۡ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ اَمۡ اَرَادَ بِهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ رَشَدًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that we do not know whether some evil has been intended (by our restriction) in respect of those people who are in the earth or their Lord intends some good for them.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاَنَّا مِنَّا الصّٰلِحُوۡنَ وَمِنَّا دُوۡنَ ذٰلِكَ‌ؕ كُنَّا طَرَآٮِٕقَ قِدَدًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that among us are some who are pious and there are also some (evil) exceptions among us. We were (following) different ways.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاَنَّا ظَنَنَّاۤ اَنۡ لَّنۡ نُّعۡجِزَ اللّٰهَ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَنۡ نُّعۡجِزَهٗ هَرَبًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And we have ascertained that we can by no means come in the way of Allah (while living) in the earth, nor can we thwart Him by escaping (from the earth).

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعۡنَا الۡهُدٰٓى اٰمَنَّا بِهٖ‌ؕ فَمَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنۡۢ بِرَبِّهٖ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخۡسًا وَّلَا رَهَقًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that when we listened to (the Book of) Guidance, we believed in it. Then he who believes in his Lord fears neither loss nor injustice.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاَنَّا مِنَّا الۡمُسۡلِمُوۡنَ وَمِنَّا الۡقٰسِطُوۡنَ‌ؕ فَمَنۡ اَسۡلَمَ فَاُولٰٓٮِٕكَ تَحَرَّوۡا رَشَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that (some) of us are obedient and (some) of us are wrongdoers as well. So he who becomes obedient, it is they who seek righteousness.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَمَّا الۡقٰسِطُوۡنَ فَكَانُوۡا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And as for the wrongdoers, they will be the fuel of Hell.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاَلَّوِ اسۡتَقَامُوۡا عَلَى الطَّرِيۡقَةِ لَاَسۡقَيۡنٰهُمۡ مَّآءً غَدَقًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And this (Revelation has also come to me) that if they had remained firm on the right path (the path of Truth, the path of the remembrance of Allah), then We would have provided them with abundant water,

Words.MeaningEn: surely We (would) have given them to drink

Verses.VerseAr: لِّنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيۡهِ‌ؕ وَمَنۡ يُّعۡرِضۡ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهٖ يَسۡلُكۡهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So that We put them to trial by this blessing. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will cause him to enter a severe torment.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاَنَّ الۡمَسٰجِدَ لِلّٰهِ فَلَا تَدۡعُوۡا مَعَ اللّٰهِ اَحَدًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that mosques are (specified) for Allah alone. So never worship anyone else besides Allah.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاَنَّهٗ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبۡدُ اللّٰهِ يَدۡعُوۡهُ كَادُوۡا يَكُوۡنُوۡنَ عَلَيۡهِ لِبَدًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that when the servant of Allah (Muhammad [blessings and peace be upon him]) stood up to worship Him they thronged around him (to listen to his recitation).

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اِنَّمَاۤ اَدۡعُوۡا رَبِّىۡ وَلَاۤ اُشۡرِكُ بِهٖۤ اَحَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘I worship only my Lord and do not associate any partner with Him.’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اِنِّىۡ لَاۤ اَمۡلِكُ لَـكُمۡ ضَرًّا وَّلَا رَشَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘I do not possess any power to do you harm (make you disbelieve) or to do you good (i.e. make you believe. So Allah is the real Lord. I am a mediator and means).’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اِنِّىۡ لَنۡ يُّجِيۡرَنِىۡ مِنَ اللّٰهِ اَحَدٌ  ۙ وَّلَنۡ اَجِدَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مُلۡتَحَدًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘Neither can anyone shelter me from a torment (against the command) of Allah, nor can I ever find refuge apart from Him alone.

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّا بَلٰغًا مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَرِسٰلٰتِهٖ‌ؕ وَمَنۡ يَّعۡصِ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوۡلَهٗ فَاِنَّ لَهٗ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاۤ اَبَدًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But (my responsibility is) to communicate from Allah His Commands and Messages. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger (blessings and peace be upon him), surely there is for him the Fire of Hell in which they will live forever.’

Verses.VerseAr: حَتّٰٓى اِذَا رَاَوۡا مَا يُوۡعَدُوۡنَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُوۡنَ مَنۡ اَضۡعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَّاَقَلُّ عَدَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Until when they will see that torment which is being promised to them, (then) they will come to know who is weaker in helpers and fewer in numbers.

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اِنۡ اَدۡرِىۡۤ اَقَرِيۡبٌ مَّا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ اَمۡ يَجۡعَلُ لَهٗ رَبِّىۡۤ اَمَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘I do not know whether that (Day of Rising) which is being promised to you is near or my Lord has appointed a longer term for that.’

Verses.VerseAr: عٰلِمُ الۡغَيۡبِ فَلَا يُظۡهِرُ عَلٰى غَيۡبِهٖۤ اَحَدًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (He is) the Knower of the unseen. So He does not inform any (common man) of His unseen,

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّا مَنِ ارۡتَضٰى مِنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ فَاِنَّهٗ يَسۡلُكُ مِنۡۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهٖ رَصَدًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Except for His Messengers with whom He is well-pleased (and reveals to them alone the Unseen because that is an exclusive trait of Prophethood and a Messenger’s miracle as well). So indeed He appoints protectors at both front and rear of him (the Messenger, for the security of the knowledge of the Unseen),

Verses.VerseAr: لِّيَـعۡلَمَ اَنۡ قَدۡ اَبۡلَغُوۡا رِسٰلٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَاَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَاَحۡصٰى كُلَّ شَىۡءٍ عَدَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: So that Allah may bring (this thing) to light that surely they (the Messengers) have communicated the Messages of their Lord and Allah has (already) encompassed what they have (of Allah’s Injunctions and the knowledge of the Unseen) and He has kept count of everything.
